proposed_widenings.name: PassiveSuppressor.on_damage_taken_until_caster_turn_start
proposed_widenings.justification: The cloak's displacement property is disabled from the instant damage is received until the start of the wearer's next turn. This is a damage-event-triggered temporary suppression with a fixed expiry (caster_turn_start), not a condition-active gate. The existing PassiveSuppressor union only supports { kind: 'condition_active', conditions: [...] }.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you take damage, the property ceases to function until the start of your next turn.

proposed_widenings.name: PassiveSuppressor.speed_is_zero
proposed_widenings.justification: The cloak's property is suppressed while the bearer's Speed is 0. Speed = 0 is a runtime numeric state, not a named condition — it can arise from Restrained, Grappled, a set_speed effect, or other sources independently of any specific condition being active. The existing PassiveSuppressor.condition_active cannot represent this accurately.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This property is suppressed while your Speed is 0.

notes: The core mechanic (all attackers have Disadvantage on attack rolls against the wearer) maps cleanly to a passive modify_roll_advantage atom. Both suppression clauses require new PassiveSuppressor variants not present in the current surface. Omitting them would encode a substantially stronger item than RAW — permanent, uninterruptible disadvantage with no conditions — so no dhall/json is authored.
